name: Simple WC ShopLinks
author: Guru Plugins

sections.description:
Simple WC ShopLinks gives you a tiny, flexible menu for WooCommerce: Login / My Account | Logout

Requires WooCommerce This plugin depends on WooCommerce to provide account/cart links.

Highlights
– Lightweight: one shortcode, small CSS, and smart WooCommerce fragment refreshes
– AJAX cart badge that updates as items are added/removed
– Choose from built-in cart icons or upload your own
– Color/size controls (text, separators, badge colors, icon height)
– Works for logged-in and logged-out users automatically
– Settings page under WooCommerce > WC ShopLinks

Shortcode
[wc_shoplinks]

Credits

Built by Christopher Harden – plugins.guru-is.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/simple-wc-shoplinks’ directory, or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the settings via the Simple WC ShopLinks dashboard.
  4. Place the shortcode wherever you want the shop links to display.

short_description: Add 'Login+My Account or Logout' links and a live-updating WooCommerce cart icon anywhere via the [wc_shoplinks] shortcode.
